Messages.Author: Frederick Scott
Messages.Body:
"Peter D Bakija" <pd...@lightlink.com> wrote in message
news:BDAD867A.1A95B%pd...@lightlink.com...

> So I asked this in my report thread, but no one answered--how do we
> officially report Infernal Plague results?

From the original storyline announcement (on the conclave) Fri, 10 Sep
2004 13:53:00 :

==========================================================================
> Reporting
> =========
> After your event, please complete the "INFERNAL PLAGUE STORYLINE
> QUESTIONNAIRE" (to be sent to the Prince list at a later date) and
> email it to inferna...@vtesinla.org. A complete Storyline
> Questionnaire is required for you event to count toward the official
> faction totals that will determine the winner of this struggle.
==========================================================================

From Robert Goudie (again on the conclave) Fri, 15 Oct 2004 08:28:17:

==========================================================================
> **** INFERNAL PLAGUE EVENT HISTORIAN'S RECORD ****
>

> Please complete this brief record of things that happened during your
> storyline tournament. Please email this report IN PLAIN TEXT FORMAT to
> inferna...@vtesinla.org no later than December 4, 2004. Reports
> sent as
> attached documents or sent after December 4th may be ignored.
>

> EVENT INFORMATION
> =================
> Organizer Name:
> Historian Name:
> Event Date:
> Event Location:
> Event City & State/Region:
> Event Country:
>

> A. TOURNAMENT WINNING CLAN:
> B. WAS THE WINNER PLAYING FOR THE INFERNAL FACTION?:
> C. WINNING PLAYER'S NAME:
> D. HOW MUCH EXTRA POOL DID THE INFERNAL PLAYERS BEGIN PLAY WITH:
> E. WINNING DECKLIST:
>

> INSTRUCTIONS AND QUESTIONS COVERING ALL ROUNDS
> ==============================================
> 1. Did Barbaro Lucchese make an impact in any game? If so, please
> describe:
> 2. Did Sela, Alan Sovereign or Quentin King III make an impact in any
> game? If so, please describe:
> 3. Please send us direct quotes of interesting things said during your
> event. Do not edit the quotes.
>

> FINALS SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS
> ============================
> 4. Please describe any interesting exchanges involving titled vampires.
> 5. Please describe any interesting Political Actions, if any.
> 6. Please describe any interesting combats.
> 7. Please describe any interesting deals made between players playing
> clans from different sects.
> 8. Please describe any other surprising or interesting situations from
> your event.
>

> EXAMPLES
> ========
> Question number five above, could be answered in the following way:
>

> 5. Jazz Wentworth called a Kine Resources Contested. The vote was
> intercepted by that player's predator who blocked using Ian Wallingford
> with the aid of KRCG News Radio for intercept.
>

> *Do not* submit reports that incorporate your own fiction. Reports that
> do so will be ignored.
==========================================================================

Gomi was also going to do the upkeep on some information webpage but I
don't know where it is or what address to send it to at the moment.
Someone else can fill us in on that?

Fre

> So I asked this in my report thread, but no one answered--how do we

On October 15th, Robert Goudie sent the "Historian Questionnaire" via
email to the Conclave mailing list, with these instructions:

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

**** INFERNAL PLAGUE EVENT HISTORIAN'S RECORD ****

Please complete this brief record of things that happened during your
storyline tournament. Please email this report IN PLAIN TEXT FORMAT
to
inferna...@vtesinla.org no later than December 4, 2004. Reports
sent as
attached documents or sent after December 4th may be ignored.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

I am not going to publicly post the whole questionnaire here, so
interested players will not know what the organizers will be looking
for in the events. :-)

Please ask in the Conclave mailing list for somebody to re-post the
original mail.

Best regards,

Hardy Range
Prince of Bochum, Germany
http://www.vekn.de
